heading-folding.fold: Fold Heading calls unfold, or folds nothing
heading-folding.unfold: Unfold Heading leaves one line hidden
heading-folding.no-gap: folding leaves blank space where the text was
heading-folding.fold-all: Fold All folds only the first top heading
heading-folding.unfold-all: Unfold All unfolds all but the last heading
heading-folding.disabled-without-heading: the fold items are always enabled
heading-outline.owned-range: a heading owns one line too many
heading-outline.fenced-code: a # line inside a fenced code block counts as a heading
main-menu.hig-order: the View and Window menus swap places
main-menu.view-fold-commands: Fold All gets a key equivalent
main-menu.drivable: a menu item has an empty title
notebook-window.open: the opened notebook drops its last line
inspector.debug-only: the inspector listens without the launch flag, or on a socket in a directory others can open
inspector.no-release-listener: one inspector source file loses its debug-only guard
inspector.settled-layout: the wait answers before layout settles
inspector.never-drives: taking a screenshot scrolls the notebook to the top
accessibility.custom-view-labels: the folded marker loses its accessibility label
